name: Mount Oriel
accommodation: Whole house, five bedrooms, sleeps up to 10
suitableFor: Families and groups, including those with dogs
parking: Secure garage for one car; free on-street parking on Church Street
boardStorage: Ground-floor storage room for equipment such as golf clubs, plus a wet room
confirmedFeatures: Sea views, wet room, washing machine, tumble dryer, dishwasher, WiFi, enclosed backyard
overview: A renovated three-storey Victorian townhouse on Portstewart Promenade with views across the Atlantic to Donegal. It sleeps up to ten in five bedrooms and has a ground-floor storage room and wet room, a washing machine and tumble dryer, and a secure garage. Portstewart Strand is about a mile along the coast, and dogs are welcome.
surfTripFit: The ground-floor store, wet room and drying facilities suit a group bringing boards and wetsuits to Portstewart Strand.
